item.description:
More choice before a break — and every exercise now starts the same way.

New

  • Any exercise can be swapped for the breathing break before it starts
  • A break can be postponed by two minutes, once per interruption
  • The recovery break's length is adjustable: two to ten minutes, five still recommended

Improved

  • All start screens share one layout, with a green start button and the exercise's symbol
  • "Restart to Update" is now a clearly visible button

Fixed

  • The menu showed "Log sessions locally" without its tick although logging was still on
  • A postponed break was counted as taken and cleared the long-focus warning — neither happens now
